name: type I-E Cascade
description: CasA, CasB, CasC, CasD and CasE, jointly required.

name: MerT-MerP transport pair
description: The inner-membrane transporter and its periplasmic binding protein, jointly required.

name: MerC transporter
description: Single protein, an alternative to MerT-MerP.

name: MerE transporter
description: Single protein, an alternative to MerT-MerP and the one that also carries organomercurials.

name: Fe/Mn superoxide dismutase
description: Single catalytic protein; the KO does not distinguish iron from manganese but both catalyse the same reaction.

name: catalase-peroxidase KatG
description: Single catalytic protein with catalase activity.

name: AhpC-AhpF peroxide-removal system
description: The peroxiredoxin catalytic subunit and its NADH-dependent reductase are jointly required.
